- **#4412**, from the same Moss note: a glitch in the text message drivers get when staging trailers on overflow lots.
- **PD-5302**, from #central-random: Hollis posted it on 14 Oct as a follow-up from this week, with no action needed.

I also told Pree what I left out and why:

- **FR-882 and PD-4821** belong to Marrow Agrisupply, which is a different account.
- **#8841** came up in #central-random on 13 Oct on "Tobias's dealer account." That might be Marrow Fieldworks, but the account isn't named, so I couldn't confirm it.
- **Nothing else turned up:** Moss's Central cheat sheet has no ticket numbers, and the other channels Pree belongs to had no messages this week.

I only used sources Pree can see herself: her channels and Moss's notes, which are public team files. Ticket numbers aren't finance figures, so no approval was needed. The notes search was keyword-only, so a ticket worded differently could have been missed.
